metric.limitation: Scores are descriptive held-out Filipe lexical cosine retrieval scores, not calibrated probabilities; they do not transfer to Henry.

preparation.dedup_protocol: exact normalized-text groups plus exhaustive char_wb TF-IDF [3,5] cosine >= 0.90 connected components; components split deterministically
preparation.missing_height_handling: fail closed; missing height count must be zero
preparation.ontology_algorithm: supplied GO metrics height field; no depth substitution
preparation.rule: retain GO terms with supplied ontology height >= 2; exclude height <= 1
preparation.stage: pre-training only; runtime predictions are never height-filtered

promotion.rollback: select go-text@2.0.0 explicitly; immutable artifacts are never overwritten

training.candidate_universe: GO labels observed in training only
training.provenance: accepted public-safe derived height-prepared and text-deduplicated artifact; no raw data included
training.representation: word and char TF-IDF; equal-weight cosine to training-group GO centroids
